title: Yuusha, Yamemasu: Kenshuu Ryokou wa Mokuteki wo Miushinau na
justification: AniList 151126 has 2 OVA episodes (2022-06-24 and 2022-08-24; 'Remember, the Work Trip is First and Foremost a Learning Opportunity'). AniDB 16917 S1 '... (Part 1)' and S2 '... (Part 2)' (前編/後編) dated 2022-06-24 and 2022-08-24. TVDB 411625 0x01 and 0x02 have the same titles (Part 1 and Part 2) and the same dates. S3 (pre-broadcast special 2022-04-01) is TVDB 0x03, not part of the entry; S4 is 'ABEMA Kaigi'.
